findings.title: recordedVersion reads the team file outside the config reader
findings.detail:
recordedVersion parses .agents/norn.config.yaml with yaml directly and picks norn_version out by hand. A YAML error is silently treated as no version. config.ts already has readConfigFile and schema validation for this file (AGENTS.md: 'never hand-roll checks of these shapes'). The result is safe, because an invalid file just falls back to the drift check, but the team file is now read in two places.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Read the worktree's team file through the store config reader (e.g. a small exported helper in config.ts) and take norn_version from the validated value.
